# Muhammad Dhiyaul Atha

> Portfolio and documentation of Muhammad Dhiyaul Atha, an Open Source Maintainer, Linux Enthusiast, DevOps and Backend Engineer based in Lhokseumawe, Indonesia.

## Primary Projects
- [NetInfo CLI Utility](https://github.com/Bangkah/netinfo): Fast and minimal Linux system/network info CLI.
- [ATHA Wrapper](https://github.com/Bangkah/Atha): Workflow wrapper for Arch Linux pacman.
- [Bangkah Launcher](https://github.com/Bangkah/bangkah-launcher): Production-ready Laravel starter kit with Docker and Nginx.
